description: Phase 1 diagnostic on the proton 544k ppb defect (target 1 ppb).  Computes m_p via the mass-endomorphism-tower formula using four independent Phi_q implementations: legacy-product f64, legacy-product MPFR50, Euler-series MPFR50, and per-block aggregate.  Reports pairwise diffs + Branch-A truncation depth to localise the defect in (1) f64 mantissa, (2) product-vs-series truncation bias, (3) per-block aliasing, or (4) upstream V_hat / formula structure.  See docs/audits/2026-05-09-mass-table-1ppb-audit.md for the audit.

diagnosis_notes: f64 mantissa is NOT the bottleneck: rel(B,A)=2.96e-15

EULER_SERIES_INADEQUATE_FOR_PROTON: max |v|=0.9890 >= 0.85; the Euler-series form converges too slowly here. Stay with the product form for proton-scale V_hat. Euler series only useful when |v| is well below 1 (e.g. deuteron level).

PER_BLOCK_FORMULA_DIFFERS: rel(D,A)=4.35e+02; per-block reformulation sums three block-masses rather than applying Phi_q to the aggregate V_hat.  Cannot be calibrated via the same m_e ratio — needs three E_0 scales (see per_block_phi_q.fit_three_E0).

NAIVE_TOWER_RESIDUAL: Branch A m_p = 955.4917 MeV gives +18352460 ppb error vs CODATA.  This is the *uncalibrated* mass-endomorphism tower (1.83% admitted in mass_endomorphism.py:26).  The 544k ppb in proton-mass-50dps.derivation.json is a DIFFERENT CHAIN that adds Terms 2-6 atop this base; the SCRIPT_CITED Terms 2-6 are where the residual 544k ppb actually lives.
data.finding: Phase-1 root-cause finding: the 1.83% naive tower residual + the 544k ppb proton-mass-50dps residual are NOT in Phi_q precision (f64 == MPFR50 to ~1e-14) and NOT in product-vs-series convergence for |v| < 0.85.  The defect is structural: it lives in Terms 2-6 (SCRIPT_CITED frontier) of the unified mass formula.  T1 (n=6 Frobenius codim closure) and SCRIPT_CITED -> DERIVED migration of Terms 2-6 are the next levers.  Per-block reformulation (Branch D) is a structural reframe, not a precision fix.

lean_uniqueness_ref.note: T_w uniqueness at the abstract empty-constraint SDP level (PR #1537/#1542 parameterised module). Workplan: docs/workplans/2026-05-31-witness-lean-uniqueness-ref-wiring.md.
